{{Quote|Choke on that, Imperial swine!|Rebel pilot hailing the destruction of the ''Vehement'' during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]|<ref name="XwA" />}}
'''''Vehement''''' was an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] in service of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The ''Vehement'' was destroyed at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] after participating in the battle between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] forces and the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]].<ref name="XwA" /><ref name="XWAOSG" />
